## Validation

- [ ] I linked or explained the before-and-after evidence for a correction or
  repository fix.
- [ ] I checked terminology against `docs/glossary.md`.
- [ ] I explained diagrams in prose and added accessible labels where relevant.
- [ ] I identified accountable owners and observable evidence for required controls.
- [ ] I labeled vendor-, jurisdiction-, and time-specific guidance.
- [ ] I added no secrets, customer data, confidential prompts, or sensitive examples.
- [ ] I ran `mkdocs build --strict`.
- [ ] I checked changed links and navigation.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff and understand the submitted change.
- [ ] Required checks and thresholds were not weakened without explicit owner
  approval.
